# computesphere_environment (Resource)

Manages an environment resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    computesphere = {
      source = "computesphere.com/computesphere/computesphere"
    }
  }
}

variable "api_token" {
  description = "API token for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "account_id" {
  description = "Account ID for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
}

variable "api_url" {
  description = "API URL for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  default     = "api.computesphere.com"
}

provider "computesphere" {
  api_token  = var.api_token  # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_TOKEN env variable
  account_id = var.account_id # or set COMPUTESPHERE_ACCOUNT_ID env variable
  api_url    = var.api_url    # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_URL env variable
}

resource "computesphere_environment" "example" {
  name       = "example-environment"
  region     = "us-east-1"
  project_id = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890ab"
}

output "environment_id" {
  value = computesphere_environment.example.id
}

output "environment_name" {
  value = computesphere_environment.example.name
}

output "environment_region" {
  value = computesphere_environment.example.region
}

output "environment_project_id" {
  value = computesphere_environment.example.project_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the environment.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID associated with the environment.
- `region` (String) Region of the environment.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp of the environment.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the environment.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = computesphere_environment.example
  identity = { id = "e1f2a3b4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = computesphere_environment.example
  id = "e1f2a3b4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an environment by its ID
terraform import computesphere_environment.example e1f2a3b4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab
```
